## Statements

- Stated by harness (pi-cli, Invocation and output): Run scripted work with pi --print and a prompt; add --mode json when you need a JSONL event stream. Redirected stdin or stdout also selects print mode.
- Stated by harness (pi-security, opening paragraph; Choose how to run Pi): Pi has no built-in sandbox and does not ask before each tool call. Run it in a container or VM, and expose only the files and credentials the task needs.
- Stated by harness (pi-security, Project trust without an interactive prompt): Headless runs skip project-local settings and extensions unless trusted. Pass --approve (or --no-approve) to make that decision explicitly for one run.
- Stated by harness (pi-cli, Models, --thinking and --model rows): Set reasoning effort with --thinking, or a :level suffix on --model. The flag overrides the suffix, and Pi clamps the level to the model's capabilities.
- Stated by harness (pi-security, Resources protected by project trust, context files paragraph): Pi loads AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md from the working folder even when project trust is declined, so keep them short and treat them as untrusted input.
